entities.name: Abd el-Ouahed ben Messaoud
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abd al-Wahid bin Mas'ud bin Mohammed Anun was the principal secretary to the Moroccan Emperor Mulay Ahmad al-Mansur and ambassador to the court of Queen Elizabeth I of England in 1600, whose primary task was to promote the establishment of an Anglo-Moroccan alliance.
